review_evidence: Declaration grep over 107 files: 103 files have at least one declaration; zero-hit files are HexGramSchmidtMathlib/Int.lean, HexResultant/Basic.lean, HexPolyDetMathlib/Bird/Audit.lean, HexPolyDetMathlib/NoFallbackTests.lean.

Read HexGramSchmidtMathlib/Int.lean completely: 4 public imports of Int/* submodules, public section, and a module docstring naming gramDet_eq_prod_normSq and the swap/row-add lemma families; retained as navigation module under FILTER-007.
Read HexResultant/Basic.lean completely: public imports of HexPoly and HexPoly.PseudoDiv, public section, docstring about the fraction-free pseudo-division kernel; retained under FILTER-007.
Read HexBerlekamp/Factored.lean completely: defines structure Hex.FpPoly.Factored (certified irreducible factorization); retained.
Read HexECPPMathlib/Hasse.lean: theorem hasse_sq_zmod (Hasse bound over ZMod p); retained.
Read HexPolyDetMathlib/Bird/Steps.lean: theorems iter_zero and iter_step about BirdDet.stepEntry iterates; retained.
Read HexPolyDetMathlib/Tactic.lean: det tactic def evalDet and simproc Hex.normPolyDet; retained as tactic interface.
Read HexLatticeEnumMathlib/LintTests.lean: defines linter docBlameThm' plus #lint commands; retained because it holds a def.

Test files HexPolyDetMathlib/Tests.lean, HexLatticeEnumMathlib/Tests.lean, HexBerlekamp/FactorTacticTests.lean contain 43, 37 and 23 line-start example/theorem/run_meta/#eval commands respectively; example statements are formal content, so they are retained.

Read HexPolyDetMathlib/Bird/Audit.lean completely (8492 bytes): one import, an open, one module docstring, and seven run_meta blocks that check cache reuse, budget exceptions and diagnostic strings of the Bird determinant tactic internals; no declaration.
Read HexPolyDetMathlib/NoFallbackTests.lean completely (399 bytes): import HexPolyDetMathlib.Tactic and one run_cmd that throws if the environment contains norm_det; no declaration.

rules.content_invariant: Every command in both files is an import, open, docstring, run_meta or run_cmd; neither file declares a def, theorem, lemma, structure, instance, example, notation, or tactic syntax, so no definition, statement, proof or interface is lost from search.
evidence: HexPolyDetMathlib/Bird/Audit.lean: read all lines; contents are `import HexPolyDetMathlib.Bird.Evaluator`, `open Lean Meta Qq Mathlib.Tactic.Ring Mathlib.Tactic.Determinant`, a docstring 'Direct checks of relation indexing, expansion reuse and entry-zero pruning.', and seven `run_meta do` blocks that call HexPolyDetMathlib.Bird.Relations.index/factors/normalize/align, Bird.withBudget and Bird.compute and throwError on failed invariants such as 'relation sum tails were not cached and reused' and 'symbolic zero-budget diagnostics changed'.

HexPolyDetMathlib/NoFallbackTests.lean: read all lines; contents are a copyright header, `import HexPolyDetMathlib.Tactic`, a comment, and `run_cmd do if (← Lean.getEnv).contains `norm_det then throwError "Hex determinant tactics must not import Mathlib's norm_det"`.
rules.rationale: These two files are build-time regression checks of tactic implementation internals (cache reuse, work budgets, diagnostic strings, absence of an imported tactic). They introduce no named declaration and state no mathematical proposition, so they only add noise to formal-mathematics search.

summary: Surveyed all 107 listed .lean files (sizes 399 to 88527 bytes) across HexBerlekamp, HexECPPMathlib, HexGramSchmidtMathlib, HexLatticeEnumMathlib, HexPolyDetMathlib, HexPolyFast, HexPolyZ, HexRationalFn and HexResultant. A line-start grep for theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/opaque/macro/syntax/elab/notation (with private/protected/noncomputable/partial/unsafe/meta modifiers) found declarations in 103 files. Of the 4 zero-hit files, HexGramSchmidtMathlib/Int.lean and HexResultant/Basic.lean are re-export modules with public section and module docstrings; they stay primary-eligible under FILTER-007 because no deployed auxiliary channel was verified. The other 2 (HexPolyDetMathlib/Bird/Audit.lean, HexPolyDetMathlib/NoFallbackTests.lean) were read completely and contain only run_meta/run_cmd tactic-implementation regression checks with no declaration, statement or proof; they are excluded. All other files are ordinary formal Lean source and are retained.
